# Welcome to Unfold

Unfold is a quiet place to write. Your notes are plain `.md` files in a folder on your Mac, so they stay yours.

## Where things are

- **Left:** sections and folders. They are real folders on your disk.
- **Middle:** your notes. Drag one onto a folder to move it.
- **Right:** the page. Click anywhere and type.

## A few things to try

- [ ] Press **Cmd+K** to jump to any note or command
- [ ] Open **Aa** to change the theme, typeface and spacing
- [ ] Press **Cmd+E** to see the raw markdown
- [ ] Pin this note with the pin at the top

## Echoes

As you write, the margin shows older notes that sound like the paragraph you are on. There is nothing to set up. It gets more useful as your notes grow.

- **Click** an echo to peek at it without leaving your note
- **Cmd-click** it, or press **Open note**, to go there
- **Cmd+[** takes you back to where you were, and **Cmd+]** goes forward

## Writing hints

Write first, polish after. Hints stay off until you ask for them.

- Press **Cmd+;** to show or hide hints. Weak spots get a dotted underline
- Hover an underline to see why, then choose **Fix** or **Ignore**
- **Right-click** in a note to refine a paragraph, a section or the whole note

## Writing help

Optional, free and private. A small AI model runs on this Mac, so your notes are not sent anywhere.

- Open **Settings** (Cmd+,) and choose **Writing help**
- Unfold walks you through it: get Ollama, download a model, done

## Small touches

- Headings get a little air above and sit close to the text below, so each one stays with its paragraph. Your file is not changed
- The style bar has one **List** button for bullets, numbers and checklists
- Give headings, links, quotes and more their own colour in **Settings**, under **Appearance**
- Press **Cmd+P** and type **tour** to see the welcome tour again

> Everything stays on this Mac. Unfold has no account and no cloud.

See [[Markdown I actually use]] for every mark Unfold understands.

# Markdown I actually use

Notes are plain `.md` files, so they open anywhere. Every mark on this page is one Unfold understands.

## Text

**Bold** for the point, *italic* for a title, ~~struck~~ for what I changed my mind about, ==highlight== for the line to find again, and `code` for anything typed exactly.

## Lists

- A plain bullet
- Another, with a [link](https://commonmark.org)
  - Indented one level

1. First step
2. Second step

- [x] A finished task
- [ ] A task still to do

### Quotes and dividers

> Plain text outlives every app that opens it.

---

## Code

```
# Heading
**bold** and *italic*
- [ ] a task
> a quote
```

## Note links and pictures

Link to another note with double brackets: [[Welcome to Unfold]].

A picture is one line. The file sits beside the note: `![A caption](photo.jpg)`

Just type. The marks hide when you leave a line and come back when you return to it. **Cmd+B** makes bold, **Cmd+E** shows the raw markdown, and `Esc` puts the cursor away.
